properties.name: formDefId
properties.label: Form / table to count within
properties.description: The formDefId whose rows are counted for the uniqueness check. Emitted by project_forms.py from the entity carrying uniqueness.

properties.name: attrs
properties.label: Unique key attributes
properties.description: Comma-separated field ids forming the unique key (e.g. tin or case_no or tin,period).

properties.name: where
properties.label: Scope predicate (HQL-qualified)
properties.description: Optional scope, already qualified for HQL by the emitter, e.g. e.customProperties.status not in ('closed') — the one-open-case-per-TIN construct.

properties.name: message
properties.label: Refusal message
properties.description: Shown to the officer when a duplicate is refused (VAL-02 grade). Falls back to a generic message when blank.
